text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov to address the parliament today to report his last year's activities and present his opinion of the political situation in the country and the entire region.

- A new plant to start operation as part of a joint venture between the Macedonian Chemical Industry OHIS of Ohrid and the ICN of Costa Mesa, California. OHIS invested 25% of the total DEM 30 million.
- Ethnic Albanian students from the Teachers' Training Faculty in Skopje stage a protest outside the Parliament, demanding all their classes be conducted in Albanian.
- Three young people died of drug-caused paralysis in Skopje in the past ten days. Doctors say the death was caused by a "special heroin spiced with cement."
